story.text: Aunt March leaves Jo her old house, Plumfield, and Jo and her Professor make it a {SCHOOL} for boys, rich ones and {POOR}. Five years on, the whole family gathers for the apple {HARVEST}: Meg’s {TWINS}, Amy and Laurie’s little Beth, and Jo’s own two {BOYS}. Marmee looks round, {PROUD} and grateful: “I can never wish you a greater {HAPPINESS} than this!”
